blockers: The build is completely silent — not placeholder audio, no audio at all. Verified against dist/, not source: 0 files matching mp3/ogg/wav/m4a/aac/opus/flac; 0 matches for AudioContext|new Audio(|createOscillator|decodeAudioData|createBufferSource across dist/assets/*.js; 0 <audio> elements; no audio dependency in package.json (pixi.js is the only runtime dep). The only media shipped are door_view_slot.webm and door_view_flight.webm, both VP8 video-only. Into The Slot O' Verse took 1.33 from a reviewer with 9 of 11 cues silent; this has zero cues. src/game/sound.svelte.ts:1-7 states it: 'nothing here plays anything'.

The sound controls are live controls that control nothing, and the product admits it on screen. MenuModal.svelte:1054-1130 renders a master switch, independent Music and Effects channels, two volume sliders and a live percentage readout; gainOf() at sound.svelte.ts:143-144 is consumed by no caller. MenuModal.svelte:1124-1129 prints to the player: 'This game has no audio yet — these settings are remembered, and apply the day sound lands.' QA-LOG-2026-08-26.md:307 (S3-2) logged autoplay and sound as dead; autoplay has since been built, sound has not.

Twenty player-visible events, no cue on any of them: boot/loader, intro card flip, PLAY press, door pick, SPIN press, reel ramp, each of five reel stops, near-miss anticipation, scatter land, line-win parade, win rungs 2-5, BIG/SUPER/MEGA/EPIC/MAX banner, coin shower, Free Spins entry plaque, free-spins ambience, the duel (shot, egg, KO stars, verdict), the shot feature, the eggs, the tractor wipe, and feature exit. The free-spins entry and the MEGA WIN are both well staged and both play in total silence.

The slot has no published maths pack and is not wired to the RGS. npm test at HEAD: 1 failed | 901 passed | 1 skipped (903); the failure is mathPack.test.ts:43. math-sdk/games/vegan_spins/library/publish_files/index.json declares only ['felixBase','felixEnhanced','felixSuperEnhanced'] — the five modes the cabinet charges for (base, bonusEnhancer, featureEnhancer, freeSpins, superFreeSpins) are absent. $stake/rgs is imported by nothing in the app; SlotApp.svelte:214-221 confirms a demo wallet with 'nothing is wagered anywhere, no round is booked'.

A debug menu ships in the production build. ?force-event on the built bundle opens a 21-button force panel (ForcePanel.svelte:46-52, force.ts:308-348) — scatter triggers, line wins, the duel, the shot, the eggs. I drove this entire review through it without building anything. vite.config.ts:66-70 also ships wild-preview as a build input, its own comment calling it 'a debug rig'.
findings: Boot fetches 400 images before PLAY is pressable. Over localhost with no network latency: PLAY-ready at 23.0s / 23.7s / 27.8s across three unthrottled runs, 465 requests (400 of them PNG), 19.1 MB. Reading the IHDR of exactly those 400 files: 134.7 megapixels, 514 MB of RGBA if resident. swipe.png (2171x1399) is fetched five separate times. dist/ carries 271 byte-identical duplicate PNGs in 67 hash groups — the same __status_effect_01__ko_* frames copied into nine rig folders, each its own request and decode. dist/ totals 60 MB. A repeatable single main-thread long task of 3528/3426/3721 ms lands during boot in all three runs — the shape of the Mummy's Riches 3.7s frozen frame.

Rig JSON parsing is ruled out as the boot cost: all 21 MB parses in 174 ms with no WebGL context in the page (worst single file 10 ms, broccoli_friendly.anim.json). The cost is image decode and upload, not parse.

The expanding-wild duel does not tier on turbo. SlotApp.svelte:2241 passes beatScale={duelScale}, and duelScale (SlotApp.svelte:144-146) is import.meta.env.DEV ? ... : 1 — pinned to 1 in every build a player touches. duelMs() (expandingWild.ts:1537-1541) over DUEL_BEATS (:1483-1530) sums to 5,017 ms when the rival wins and 5,417 ms when the hen does, identical at turbo off, single and double. It is a cosmetic beat that gates what the wild reel is worth. Everything else does tier and is tested for it: spin (TURBO_SCALE [1, 0.5, 0.28], spinMotion.ts:692), aubergine fall, round gate, screen shake, tractor wipe, win parade, camera push.

Text is occluded on the first screen the player sees. The middle intro card's subtitle '& SUPER FREE SPINS' (IntroScreen.svelte:271, rendered :863/:874) is cut horizontally through the middle of its glyphs by the symbol canvas the .intro-card__actor spacer reserves (:1353-1361). At 1280x800 the visible text reads '& SUPER FREE' with the lower half sheared off and 'SPINS' gone. .intro-card__sub (:1344-1352) carries no stacking context. It is the card describing the headline feature.

No keyboard binding on the bet button. grep -c -E 'keydown|keyup' src/SlotApp.svelte src/ui/ControlBar.svelte returns 0 — spacebar does nothing. QA-LOG-2026-08-26.md:317 logged this as S3-3 and it is still true at HEAD.

The balance credits before the win is announced. On the forced 5x Red chilli round the bar read BALANCE $1,362.00 with WIN $0.00 as the per-line parade began; the MEGA WIN plaque and WIN $363.00 arrived about ten seconds later. Money reconciles exactly (1000 - 1 + 363) and formats to 2dp with no rounding, so this is presentation order rather than a money bug.

CREDIT — win presentation is proportional and skippable: a ten-rung ladder from zero to MAX WIN, present durations 0 to 32s, thresholds measured not guessed (winBanner.ts:59-110). A minimum win moves the meter only; 362x raised a wooden MEGA WIN plaque, coin shower and farmer cheer with 'TAP TO CONTINUE' and a global pointerdown skip (SlotApp.svelte:1277).

CREDIT — the animations-end-abruptly disease is not present. SpriterPlayer carries ended, onEnd, onLoop and loopOverride (SpriterPlayer.ts:171-176, 369-389) so one-shots stop and hold their final pose. banter.ts:189 derives its window from the clips (Math.max(lengthOf(fromClip), answerAfterMs + lengthOf(toClip))) rather than a flat hold; DuelScene.svelte:615-617 derives FX playback speed and end time from the clip's own duration. docs/ANIMATIONS.md:7-12 names the Spriter default-true looping trap and tells call sites to force loop:false.

CREDIT — the twentieth consecutive loss holds. Twenty forced no-win spins and the grid never became twenty copies of one idle: banter.ts runs nudge-and-answer pairs between neighbouring vegetables and the farmer idles in the field.

CREDIT — clean console across boot, intro, door pick, slot entry, six spins, a forced feature and a forced MEGA WIN: no page errors, no failed requests. No emoji in the shipped bundle. Build is clean and filename-law passes 862 files.
CREDIT — the art and the Super Free Spins entry are the strongest in this catalogue: night-sky mode swap, wheat, godrays and a CONGRATULATIONS plaque that reads as a proper feature entry.
lift: Ship audio — not the full bus, the five cues that stop the game reading as unfinished: a base music loop, spin start, reel stop, one win cue switching on the WIN_LADDER rung winBanner.ts already computes, and a free-spins entry fanfare, each taking its gain from the musicGain()/sfxGain() the mixer already returns. That alone moves this from 1.33 to 1.67; I would trade every other fix on the list for the reels making a noise.
could_not_verify: Frame rate on hardware a reviewer would own. This container has no GPU — default, --use-gl=egl and explicit SwiftShader all resolved to ANGLE (Vulkan 1.3.0, SwiftShader Device (Subzero)). A trivial WebGL clear ran at 58 fps there; the real Pixi stage ran under 2 fps unthrottled, making every wall-clock frame time worthless (the trap mummysriches/tools/browser.mjs warns about). No defensible fps or worst-frame figure for the phase transitions, and the score does not pretend otherwise.
Whether the repeatable ~3.5s boot long task survives on real hardware. Image decode is CPU work and would partly survive; upload would not.
Portrait, mobile and Popout S (400x225) layouts — driven at 1280x800 only.
Mid-round refresh and resume — there is no served round to interrupt.
Real RGS behaviour: bet levels from authenticate, non-USD currency formatting, replay. Not wired, so a reviewer will find the same absence.
Felix's Flight — entered through the Vegan Spins door and stayed there for the session.
